verdicts.explanation: The main text (Section 2.4) reports Li2MnCl4 at 5.59 × 10−4 mS/cm with no measurement temperature, and the value is from this paper's own campaign. The supplement's 5.95 × 10−6 S/cm (Index 29) is a internal inconsistency, but the quoted main-text value is what the paper reports for this material.
Section 2.4 reports Li2FeCl4 at 1.14 × 10−2 mS/cm, matching the supplement's 1.14 × 10−5 S/cm (Index 28). No measurement temperature is given, so null is correct.

Section 2.4 states Li1.8Fe0.8In0.2Cl4 at 2.72 × 10−2 mS/cm, and the value is from this paper's campaign. The supplement's 2.15 × 10−5 S/cm at 450 °C is a separate sample, and the 450 °C is a synthesis temperature, not a measurement temperature, so null is correct.
Section 2.4 says the composition designed to remove indium, Li1.8Fe1.1Cl4, reached 4.30 × 10−2 mS/cm. The supplement (Index 194) agrees, and no measurement temperature is stated.
Section 2.4 reports Li1.8Mn1.1Cl4 at 1.75 × 10−2 mS/cm as the result of this campaign, and the supplement (Index 250, 1.75 × 10−5 S/cm) agrees. No measurement temperature is stated.
Section 2.3 gives Li1.45Mn0.45Sc0.55Cl4 at 0.144 mS/cm (Supplementary Note S10), matching Index 318 (1.44 × 10−4 S/cm). The measurement temperature is not stated in the paper, so null is correct.

Section 2.3 gives Li1.5Mn0.25Fe0.25Y0.25In0.25Cl4 at 0.136 mS/cm (Supplementary Note S9), matching Index 324 (1.36 × 10−4 S/cm). The paper gives no measurement temperature, and the Y and In dopant assignment is consistent with the paper.
